concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a highly polished landscape art-direction board for an ORIGINAL sci-fi survival arena game, inspired by the tactile organic machinery and nature-sovereign emotional tone of The Wild Robot and the surreal ecological logic of Scavengers Reign. Do not copy characters, logos or movie scenes. Story: displaced humans have colonized a huge lush Earth-like planet; its simple organisms self-reprogram to pursue humans as an immune response. Nature is ancient, beautiful and indifferent, never evil. Humanity is tiny, fragile, and needs to coexist. Board composition: upper 65 percent is one large coherent detailed GAMEPLAY CONCEPT at an elevated near-top-down camera (roughly 70 degrees above ground), readable walkable arena clearing, small distinctive human figures and several biologically plausible seed-pod/chitin sentinels, immense flora at perimeter and wreckage give scale. Organic UI must be visibly included in the gameplay image: low unobtrusive tangible symbiotic membrane at bottom edge with crisp readable 'RUN 01:24', a small breathing lamella organ labeled 'SPRINT', a small leaf-vein map, and 'GEN 08 · 00:18' nestled in a seed casing at top. Use generous dark backing for legibility. No health bar (one touch ends a run), no weapons/ammo/crosshair, no neon holographic panels, no metallic HUD boxes, no floating health markers. Organic feedback grows from a wearable symbiont, not decorative leaves pasted onto standard menus. Keep the center free of UI. Bottom 35 percent: three clear large specimen panels with original player silhouette, sentinel morphology (closed harmless seed and open active insect), and enlarged UI organ, each showing purposeful fine detail. Clean restrained editorial captions, only the exact board title and small labels 'SURVIVOR', 'SENTINEL', 'LIVING INTERFACE'. These are proposed concept paintings, not real gameplay screenshots. Strong readable graphic silhouette design, cinematic atmosphere, refined painterly animation look, intentional negative space, avoid photoreal gritty military space marines, generic robots, candy neon, unreadable clutter.
Title '01 / VERDANT WOUND'. Art direction: immense moss-covered cathedral tree roots reclaim a shattered ivory ceramic colony lander; prehistoric fern fans, umbrella foliage, sun shafts through jade mist, restrained bioluminescent veins. A scar of pale colony flooring in the forest clearing is the arena, bounded by root buttresses with four readable root-arch passages; natural floor obstacle mounds distinct from traversable ground. Palette deep forest jade, warm bone ceramic, amber spores, pale mint. Warm late-afternoon light and overwhelming living scale; inviting beauty with quiet threat. Humans: small asymmetric salvaged ivory ceramic rain-shell, rust-orange cloth sash, dark soft boots, compact seed-shaped life-support backpack, visible human gait and narrow dark visor; not the Wild Robot character. Sentinels: floating translucent jade seed capsules with a glowing amber nucleus, split into three veined petals and two compact dark chitin steering fins when active, no face or evil eyes; dormant folded pearl seed. UI symbiont: pale matte lichen membrane, four clearly countable lamellae contract with sprint energy, branching vein map. Bottom specimens on warm botanical-paper ground with natural ink details.

Title '02 / GLASS TIDE'. Art direction: an immense alien floodplain garden with translucent bladder trees and arching coral-like reeds, pearl river terraces and mossy plateaus over clear dark-teal water, lilac mist and huge pale floating seed canopies. Ancient drowned colony hull ribs are small compared to flora. A readable continuous shallow-water/solid-silt arena floor, four shell arch passages and clear solid obstacle islands; avoid a platform-jumping map. Palette petrol teal, pale celadon, lilac shadows, pearl, restrained coral-orange threat accents. Luminous overcast dawn, strange gentle daylight, biological surrealism, clean hand-painted graphic contours. Humans: long split kelp-fiber storm mantle, small ochre faceless ceramic breathing hood, asymmetric side-carried salvaged field kit, dark legs, visibly human silhouette, no weapons. Sentinels: buoyant transparent seed-pod bodies containing branching nerves and a coral nucleus, with three compact chitin stabilizers and trailing fine cilia; closed pearl eggs unfold into asymmetrical insect/pod hunters. They hover close to ground. UI symbiont: translucent wet pearl membrane stretched over fine cartilaginous ribs, soft ciliated breath comb and pigment dots, small dark-backed numerals and vein map. Bottom specimens on pale lavender-gray naturalist board. Distinct from dark fantasy and from a conventional green jungle.

Title '03 / MYCELIAL CHOIR'. Art direction: an immense dusk rainforest where black-violet trunks and giant bracket fungi are connected by fine bioluminescent capillary threads; lush fern carpet, pale shell-like flowers, abandoned colony observatory broken and engulfed by living tissue in the background. Readable desaturated moss arena clearing, four passage gaps framed by massive fungal root buttresses, amber mycelial nest at center; keep walkable ground quiet and threats well contrasted. Palette ink indigo, desaturated mint, warm fungal ivory, small amber danger signals. Moody cinematic blue dusk and soft luminous spores, no strobing, breathtaking ecological scale not horror gore. Humans: compact warm ivory felt/ceramic shell suit with one distinctive folded leaf shoulder cape, tiny visible human head/visor, two dark legs and amber woven waist marker, minimal attached seed-shaped support gear. Sentinels: compact black chitin crescent with three ivory petal fins, translucent amber seed abdomen and fine sensing antennae; look like an insect/seed hybrid rather than a spaceship. Dormant organism is closed ivory husk, active version unfolds dark blades and exposed luminous seed. UI symbiont: physical dark soft membrane with ivory vein tracks, amber sap collecting in respiration chambers, small crisp neutral typography and vein map; signals convey body/connection feedback. Bottom specimen panels on deep ink botanical-study ground, exceptionally legible silhouettes.
